step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulation (DSM) Sensing Circuit for Resistive Memory
step1_figure.description: The circuit senses a 1T1R resistive memory cell using a first-order delta-sigma modulator consisting of a switched-capacitor charge pump (M1-M4, Ccup), bit line capacitance (Cbit), and a clocked comparator with built-in input offset (Fig. 17.16) that regulates the bit line voltage to VDD/2 + Vos.

q_cup.description: Charge packet dumped into the bit line per enabled clock cycle

equation.explanation: Amount of charge transferred from the switched capacitor Ccup through PMOS cascode/switch devices into the bit line node during one clock discharge phase.
equation.assumptions: M1 fully precharges Ccup to VDD; M4 source settles to VREF + |VTHP|.

sky130_expected.reasoning: VTHP variations across process corners and incomplete settling slightly alter the delivered charge.

delta_vbit.description: Peak-to-peak bit line voltage variation (ripple) per charge dumping cycle

equation.explanation: Change in bit line voltage resulting from dumping one packet of charge Q_cup onto bit line capacitance Cbit.
equation.assumptions: Charge conservation on Cbit during transient injection.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ccup = 100 fF, Cbit = 500 fF, Q_cup = 88 fC. delta_Vbit = 88 fC / 500 fF = 176 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ratio Ccup/Cbit = 0.2 scale the 0.88 V voltage head across Ccup.

equation.formula: V_os = V(In+) - V(In-) at comparator decision trip point
equation.explanation: Offset intentionally introduced by widening the In- input transistor (13/1 vs 10/1) to force a positive sensing reference voltage offset from VREF.
equation.assumptions: Balanced load and dynamic latch symmetry.

sky130_expected.calculation: Target offset in Baker design is ~50 mV. Sizing ratio W_inm/W_inp = 1.3/1.0 yields roughly delta_Vgs = sqrt(2*Id/(mu*Cox))*(sqrt(1/1.0) - sqrt(1/1.3)) ~ 40 to 60 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by differential pair geometric imbalance and threshold matching.

vbit_avg.description: Average steady-state bit line voltage held by DSM feedback loop

equation.explanation: The closed-loop delta-sigma modulator forces the average bit line voltage to equal the comparator threshold reference voltage.
equation.assumptions: Sufficient loop gain and complete modulator lock without saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: VREF = 0.5 V, V_os = 50 mV. Vbit_avg = 0.50 + 0.05 = 0.55 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Feedback tracks the offset threshold closely in periodic limit cycle.

i_mbit.description: Average sensing current flowing through the resistive memory element

equation.explanation: Since Rmbit connects between bit line (held at VREF + Vos) and VREF, the voltage across Rmbit is Vos.
equation.assumptions: Bitline held at average voltage VREF + Vos; memory access switch on-resistance is negligible.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_os = 50 mV, Rmbit = 25 kOhm. I_mbit = 50 mV / 25 kOhm = 2.0 uA = 2.0e-6 A.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct Ohm's law current across the memory resistor for Vos in 30-80 mV range.

r_sc_min.description: Minimum equivalent switched-capacitor resistance (when feedback switch M3 is always active)

equation.explanation: Small-signal/average resistance synthesized by the switched-capacitor network under continuous maximum charge transfer.
equation.assumptions: Clock frequency f_clk = 100 MHz, complete settling each cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ccup = 100 fF, f_clk = 100 MHz (T = 10 ns). R_sc_min = 1 / (100e-15 * 100e6) = 100 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Inherent property of switched capacitor with 100 fF clocked at 100 MHz.

r_mbit_min.description: Minimum detectable memory resistance before modulator output saturates at all 1s (M=N)

equation.formula: R_mbit_min = (V_os * T) / ((VDD - VREF - |VTHP|) * Ccup) = V_os * T / Q_cup
equation.explanation: The lowest resistance where the maximum feedback charge pump current (M/N = 1) can balance the current drawn by Rmbit.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_os = 50 mV, T = 10 ns, Q_cup = 88 fC. R_mbit_min = (0.05 * 10e-9) / 88e-15 = 5.68 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends directly on Vos and Qcup.

r_mbit_max.description: Maximum finite detectable memory resistance for N=50 clock cycles (M=1)

equation.formula: R_mbit_max = R_mbit_min * N = (V_os * T * N) / Q_cup
equation.explanation: Resistance corresponding to exactly 1 pulse out of N clock periods.

sky130_expected.calculation: R_mbit_min = 5.68 kOhm, N = 50. R_mbit_max = 5.68 kOhm * 50 = 284 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct N-times scaling of minimum resistance.

m_ratio.description: DSM feedback pulse duty ratio M/N for Rmbit = 25 kOhm

equation.explanation: Average fraction of clock periods in which feedback capacitor dumps charge to balance the memory resistor current.

sky130_expected.calculation: R_mbit_min = 5.68 kOhm, Rmbit = 25 kOhm. M/N = 5.68 / 25 = 0.227 (~11 pulses out of 50).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determines the digital output code of the DSM ADC.

i_dd_avg.description: Average supply current drawn from VDD during sensing operation

equation.explanation: Total average current drawn from the 1.8V supply including switched capacitor pumping and comparator dynamic clocking.

sky130_expected.calculation: Switched cap current = 88 fC * 100 MHz * 0.227 = 2.0 uA. Clocked comparator and clock buffer switching adds ~20-30 uA. Total I_dd_avg ~ 25 to 40 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by dynamic capacitance charging of internal nodes and Ccup at 100 MHz.

step3_testbench.description: Transient simulation testbench for DSM resistive memory sensor (Fig. 17.18) measuring bit line DC voltage, ripple delta_Vbit, average current, supply power, and DSM output pulse count over 50 clock cycles (500 ns).
step3_testbench.spice:
* DSM Sensing Circuit for Resistive Memory (Baker Fig 17.18)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter definitions for transistor geometries
.param W_xm1=1.0u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=2.0u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=2.0u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=2.0u L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1.0u L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=1.0u L_xm6=0.15u
.param W_xm7=2.0u L_xm7=0.15u
.param W_xm8=1.0u L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=1.0u L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=1.3u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=1.0u L_xm11=0.15u
.param W_xm12=1.0u L_xm12=0.15u

* Power Supplies
VDD VDD 0 1.8
VREF VREF 0 500m

* Non-overlapping two-phase clocks and comparator clock (T = 10ns, f = 100MHz)
* phi1: active-low PMOS precharge (0.5ns to 3.5ns)
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0.5n 0.1n 0.1n 3.0n 10n)
* clock: comparator evaluate pulse (4.0ns to 8.5ns)
Vclk clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 4.0n 0.1n 0.1n 4.5n 10n)
* phi2: active-low PMOS dump switch (5.5ns to 8.5ns)
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 5.5n 0.1n 0.1n 3.0n 10n)

* Circuit Under Test (Fig. 17.18)
xm3 N001 phi1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm1 N002 phi2 N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N004 N003 N002 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
C1 N001 0 1e-13
xm4 vbit VREF N004 N004 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
X_U1 vbit VREF N003 Out clock VDD 0 SUB_1
Cbit vbit 0 5e-13
R1 VREF vbit 25000.0

* Subcircuits from Netlist
.subckt SUB_1 inp inm q qi clock VDD GND
  xm1 N003 inp GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
  xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
  xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
  xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
  xm10 N004 inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
  X_U1 Outp q qi VDD 0 NAND_2
  X_U2 qi Outm q VDD 0 NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

* Initial condition for smooth startup
.ic v(vbit)=0.55

.control
* Run 50 cycles (500 ns) of DSM sensing
tran 0.05n 500n

* Measurements in steady-state (100ns to 500ns)
meas tran vbit_avg avg v(vbit) from=100n to=500n
meas tran vbit_max max v(vbit) from=100n to=500n
meas tran vbit_min min v(vbit) from=100n to=500n
let delta_vbit = vbit_max - vbit_min
print delta_vbit

* Built-in offset Vos = Vbit_avg - VREF (where VREF = 0.5V)
let v_os = vbit_avg - 0.5
print v_os

* Resistor current
let i_mbit = v_os / 25000.0
print i_mbit

* Average supply current
meas tran idd_avg avg i(VDD) from=100n to=500n
let pwr_avg = -idd_avg * 1.8
print idd_avg pwr_avg

* Pulse counting at comparator output Q (N003)
* Note: N003 enables PMOS M3 when active low
meas tran n_dump_pulses count v(N003) val=0.9 fall=1 from=100n to=500n
let m_ratio = n_dump_pulses / 40.0
print n_dump_pulses m_ratio

quit
.endc
.end
